facts.fact: The government lists as planned tasks an interoperability programme with all service sectors using identification data, synchronisation of communal registers with the RNPP, and voter-centre notification with the elections directorate.
The government says the RNPP gives each person enrolled with biometric data a personal identification number (NPI), operated by ANIP.
The government says digital identity expertise is rare in Benin and recruited a Rwandan national as external collaborator to direct ANIP for the next phase.
